Share repurchases were 2,517 (table in millions) in the nine months against 5,618 a year earlier, and dividends paid were 3,606 against 3,685. The company suspended its buyback program in the third quarter.
quotes: Comcast suspended its share repurchase program beginning in the third quarter and expects the pause to remain in place through the proposed separation of its businesses into two independent publicly traded companies.

financial_health.basis: Timing is stated in P4 and the conditions in P5; the link to refinancing is inferred from the reference to financing arrangements.
financial_health.claim: Refinancing is tied to the planned NBCUniversal and Sky spin-off. The spin-off is expected mid-2027, and one of its conditions is completion of financing arrangements. How existing debt would be divided or refinanced is not described in the evidence.
quotes: The NBCUniversal Spin-off will be subject to the satisfaction of customary conditions, including obtaining final approval by our Board of Directors, receipt of tax opinions and regulatory approvals, and completion of financing arrangements.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the Q3 earnings release table and commentary.
growth_thesis.claim: Domestic wireless is the clearest growth line in Residential Connectivity: wireless service revenue rose to 1,050 from 915 (table in millions), up 14.7%, and total lines reached 10.6 million.
quotes: Domestic wireless service revenue increased, reflecting growth in the customer base and the conversion of promotional free lines to paid service.

growth_thesis.basis: Net additions and the conversion comment are stated in the release. That conversion must continue is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: For wireless growth to continue, free lines must keep converting to paid and line additions must hold up. Net additions were 368,000 against 414 (table in thousands) a year earlier.
quotes: strong conversion of free wireless lines to paid relationships

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the Q3 earnings release; the conditional is inferred from those figures.
growth_thesis.claim: Wireless growth has to outrun broadband erosion. Domestic broadband revenue fell 4.7% to 6,241 from 6,550 (table in millions), and domestic broadband residential customers had net losses of 144 (table in thousands).
quotes: Domestic broadband revenue decreased due to lower average rates and a decline in the number of domestic broadband customers.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the Q3 earnings release.
growth_thesis.claim: Business Services Connectivity, led by enterprise solutions, is a steady growth contributor. Revenue rose 2.7% to 2,645 (table in millions) and Adjusted EBITDA rose 1.7% to 1,478.
quotes: Revenue for Business Services Connectivity increased primarily due to an increase in revenue from enterprise solutions offerings.

growth_thesis.basis: Figures and drivers are stated in the Q3 release. The conditions for continuation are inferred from the stated drivers and the 10-K risk factor.
growth_thesis.claim: Peacock is a growth driver and has turned profitable: Adjusted EBITDA of $261 million on $1.8 billion of revenue, with paid subscribers up 17% to 48 Million. Continued growth needs further distribution revenue gains, from higher average rates and more paid subscribers.
quotes: Peacock delivered its second consecutive profitable quarter, generating $261 million in Adjusted EBITDA on $1.8 billion in revenue, driven by strong growth in distribution
Domestic distribution revenue increased primarily due to higher revenue at Peacock, driven by higher average rates and an increase in paid subscribers compared to the prior year period.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the Q3 release; that the film slate must keep delivering is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Studios profit rose on theatrical strength. Studios Adjusted EBITDA rose 18.6% to 402 (table in millions) as theatrical revenue rose 76.6% to 1,129 from 639. Continuation depends on further hit releases.
quotes: Theatrical revenue increased primarily due to the successful performance of recent releases, including The Odyssey and Minions & Monsters, as well as the carryover benefit of Obsession.

growth_thesis.basis: Latest-quarter figures are stated in the release; the prior-year driver is stated in the 10-K. That admissions must recover is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Theme Parks is a headwind to growth in the latest quarter. Revenue fell 4.4% to 2,597 from 2,717 (table in millions) and Adjusted EBITDA fell to 780 from 940. For it to resume growth, admissions must recover despite increased promotional activity.
quotes: Revenue for Theme Parks decreased primarily due to lower revenue from park admissions, including from the impact of increased promotional activity.
Revenue increased primarily due to an increase in revenue at our theme parks in Orlando, driven by the opening of Epic Universe in May 2025.

growth_thesis.basis: Figures are stated in the cited items; the link between share count and EPS is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Per-share earnings are growing faster than net income because of a shrinking share count and lower interest cost. Diluted EPS was 0.97 against 0.90, net income attributable to Comcast rose 3.5%, diluted weighted shares fell to 3,562 from 3,689 (millions), and interest expense fell to 962 from 1,128 (table in millions).
quotes: Consolidated interest expense decreased for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025 primarily due to a decrease in average debt outstanding.

growth_thesis.basis: The suspension and the repurchase amounts are stated; the effect on EPS is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: The buyback support to EPS may fade. Repurchases were 2,517 in the nine months against 5,618 a year earlier (table in millions), and the program is suspended through the proposed separation.
quotes: Comcast suspended its share repurchase program beginning in the third quarter

growth_thesis.basis: Figures are stated in the cited statements and release; the link between free cash flow and repayments is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Cash generation funds deleveraging. Free cash flow was $4.2 billion (4,211 against 4,945, down 14.8%), and nine-month debt repayments of 10,405 (table in millions) helped cut noncurrent debt to 83,806 from 92,979. Continuation requires free cash flow to hold.
quotes: We generated $4.2 billion in free cash flow

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the Q3 release; the conclusion about the base is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: After adjusting for the Versant separation and the Germany sale, the base is roughly stable: pro forma revenue was 29,298 against 29,151 and pro forma Adjusted EBITDA was 9,106 against 9,038 (table in millions). The reported decline is largely structural, so the growth drivers above must add to a flat base.
quotes: revenue and Adjusted EBITDA were consistent with the prior year period.

material_events.claim: Comcast completed the separation of Versant into an independent, publicly traded company, distributing 100% of Versant shares to Comcast shareholders.
quotes: The Versant Separation occurred on January 2, 2026.

material_events.claim: Comcast completed the sale of its Sky operations in Germany; results are included in consolidated results through the sale date and excluded from segment results.
quotes: The sale of our Sky operations in Germany was completed on May 31, 2026

material_events.claim: Comcast announced its intention to separate into two independent publicly traded companies through a tax-free spin-off of NBCUniversal and Sky. Completion is expected in mid-2027 and is subject to customary conditions.
quotes: In June 2026, we announced our intention to separate into two independent publicly traded companies through a tax-free spin-off of NBCUniversal and Sky.

material_events.claim: Comcast suspended its share repurchase program starting in the third quarter and expects the pause to last through the proposed separation.
quotes: Comcast suspended its share repurchase program beginning in the third quarter and expects the pause to remain in place through the proposed separation of its businesses into two independent publicly traded companies.

risks.basis: Stated in the Q3 release and the 10-K risk factors; the link to long-run erosion is inferred.
risks.claim: Residential Connectivity & Platforms is under pressure: Q3 Adjusted EBITDA was $6,110 against $6,484 a year earlier (table in millions), and domestic broadband residential customer net losses were 144,000.
quotes: Domestic broadband revenue decreased due to lower average rates and a decline in the number of domestic broadband customers.
Our businesses operate in intensely competitive, consumer-driven, rapidly changing environments.

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A and risk factors.
risks.claim: The planned spin-off of NBCUniversal and Sky is not certain and could be delayed or fail. It is expected in mid-2027 and depends on board approval, tax opinions, regulatory approvals and financing.
quotes: The NBCUniversal Spin-off is expected to be completed in mid-2027, subject to the satisfaction of customary conditions.
There is no guarantee that the NBCUniversal Spin-off, if completed, will be successful in meeting its objectives or achieving its intended benefits.

risks.claim: If the NBCUniversal Spin-off were determined to be taxable, Comcast and/or its shareholders could face substantial taxes and significant liabilities.
quotes: In addition, although we intend for the NBCUniversal Spin-off to be tax-free to our shareholders for U.S. federal income tax purposes, there can be no assurance that the NBCUniversal Spin-off will qualify as tax-free and, if the NBCUniversal Spin-off is ultimately determined to be taxable, we and/or holders of our common stock could be subject to substantial U.S. and/or applicable non-U.S. taxes as a result, and we could incur significant liabilities under applicable law.

risks.basis: Stated in the Q3 release; the characterisation of the cause is management's.
risks.claim: Theme Parks earnings are weakening: Q3 Adjusted EBITDA was $780 against $940 a year earlier (table in millions), with lower park admissions revenue and more promotional activity.
quotes: Revenue for Theme Parks decreased primarily due to lower revenue from park admissions, including from the impact of increased promotional activity.

risks.basis: The event contribution is stated; the recurrence concern is inferred.
risks.claim: Part of the Q3 Media improvement came from a one-off event: the FIFA World Cup added $224 million of incremental revenue, and Media revenue growth was 8.3% without it. Gains in Media may not recur once the event is excluded.
quotes: Excluding $224 million of incremental revenue from the FIFA World Cup, Media revenue increased 8.3%.

risks.basis: Balance-sheet and cash-flow figures are stated; the risk framing is inferred, and the evidence does not identify a specific liquidity threat.
risks.claim: The company carries sizeable debt: $3,560 current and $83,806 noncurrent against $7,596 of cash (table in millions), and nine-month operating cash flow fell to $22,886 from $24,802.

unresolved_questions.basis: Stated in P4 and P5; the 'on track' language is in P6.
unresolved_questions.claim: Will the NBCUniversal and Sky spin-off close on the expected mid-2027 timeline and qualify as tax-free? The filings say it depends on unmet conditions.
quotes: The NBCUniversal Spin-off is expected to be completed in mid-2027, subject to the satisfaction of customary conditions.
There can be no assurance that a separation transaction will occur, or, if one does occur, of its terms or timing.

unresolved_questions.basis: The debt figures are in F1 and the financing condition is in P5. The allocation is not in the evidence, so the open question is inferred.
unresolved_questions.claim: How will the existing debt be split between the two companies after the spin-off, and what financing arrangements are planned? At September 30, 2026 the balance sheet showed 83,806 of noncurrent debt and 3,560 of current debt (table in millions).
quotes: The NBCUniversal Spin-off will be subject to the satisfaction of customary conditions, including obtaining final approval by our Board of Directors, receipt of tax opinions and regulatory approvals, and completion of financing arrangements.

unresolved_questions.basis: Management's explanation is stated in P6 and P4. Whether the decline is temporary is inferred as unresolved, because the evidence gives no duration.
unresolved_questions.claim: Is the Residential Connectivity & Platforms Adjusted EBITDA decline temporary investment in the go-to-market strategy, or does it reflect lasting competitive pressure? Q3 Adjusted EBITDA was 6,110 against 6,484 a year earlier (table in millions), and the margin fell to 35.9% from 36.8%.
quotes: Residential Connectivity & Platforms revenue and Adjusted EBITDA performance reflect the investment in our go-to-market strategy.
Our customer relationship net additions/(losses) continue to be negatively impacted by an increasingly competitive environment.

unresolved_questions.basis: The pause is stated in P6 and the repurchase figures are in F3. The post-separation policy is not in the evidence.
unresolved_questions.claim: How long will the share repurchase pause last, and what dividend and buyback policy will each company follow after the separation? Nine-month repurchases fell to 2,517 from 5,618 (table in millions).
quotes: As previously announced, Comcast suspended its share repurchase program beginning in the third quarter and expects the pause to remain in place through the proposed separation of its businesses into two independent publicly traded companies.

unresolved_questions.basis: The figures and management's cyclical framing are stated in P6. The cause is not established, so the question is inferred.
unresolved_questions.claim: Are the Theme Parks declines cyclical, or do they stem from lower admissions revenue and higher promotional activity? Q3 Adjusted EBITDA was 780 against 940 (table in millions), a 17.1% decrease.
quotes: Despite near-term cyclical headwinds in Theme Parks, we remain confident in the business's long-term growth potential.
Revenue for Theme Parks decreased primarily due to lower revenue from park admissions, including from the impact of increased promotional activity.

unresolved_questions.basis: The balance sheet change is in F1. The Versant, Germany sale and impairment items are in P4. The allocation is not in the packet.
unresolved_questions.claim: How much of the fall in goodwill and other intangibles came from the Versant separation, the Sky Germany sale, or impairments? Goodwill went to 53,239 from 61,502 (table in millions).
quotes: increased impairments of certain long-lived assets in the current year period compared to the prior year period

unresolved_questions.basis: The inclusion of World Cup amounts is stated in P6. The size of the effect is not given, so the question is inferred.
unresolved_questions.claim: How much of Peacock's $261 million Q3 Adjusted EBITDA came from the one-time FIFA World Cup, and is the profit repeatable in quarters without that event?
quotes: which includes amounts attributable to the FIFA World Cup

verdict_reason: expected return +26.3 points a year against the required return over 3 years
